scope: Actual documentation renderer and viewer modules in an isolated loopback fixture; no running Studio, product build, project writes or model calls.
checks: Verification content contains only nine dated JSON record links and no image or Markdown links.
Actual retained record opens in-place and is formatted with two-space indentation.
Native modal keeps keyboard focus within Close and the keyboard-scrollable JSON region.
Escape closes the dialog, restores link focus and restores page scrolling.
HTML-looking JSON values remain escaped text and never execute.
Mobile modal fits the viewport and long JSON lines scroll inside the record.
Malformed JSON has a clear error, clears prior content and can be retried.
Oversize responses are bounded before JSON parsing.
Loading state is announced; closing aborts a pending record and late data cannot replace the next record.
Missing records and dialog controls support German interface language.
Without JavaScript each record remains a normal JSON link.
No browser exceptions; fixture requests are read-only GETs.
